description: Tesseract English LSTM model used by the OCR service. Downloaded and verified at build time by scripts/fetch-language-data.mjs; in production the service reads only this verified file.
provenance: Same file as the default URL Tesseract.js 7 uses (lstmOnly), pinned to @tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0. downloadSha256 matches jsDelivr's published hash and the file in the npm tarball verified against the registry's sha512 integrity.
